summary: Converting owner-backed Bytes into Vec<u8> copies the contents but leaks the owner because owned_to_vec does not release its reference and the conversion suppresses Bytes destruction with ManuallyDrop. The fix releases the reference after copying and removes the now-redundant release from owned_to_mut. The added test owned_into_vec in tests/test_bytes.rs checks that the owner is dropped once. Reversing both functions restores the historical leak while preserving BytesMut conversion behavior. No tests were executed.
